faqs.question: Can our company claim Input Tax Credit (ITC) on Victor Mobility invoices?
faqs.answer: Yes. When billed under the 12% GST forward-charge rate with SAC 9966, enterprise corporate clients with active GST registrations can claim 100% Input Tax Credit against their business tax liabilities.

faqs.question: How are electronic Fastag tolls and airport parking fees accounted for?
faqs.answer: All Fastag toll transactions and airport parking tickets are recorded digitally and itemized on the duty slip with electronic transaction IDs, ensuring zero manual markup or discrepancy.

faqs.question: What documentation is required to establish a 30-day corporate credit account?
faqs.answer: Standard corporate onboarding requires your company PAN, Certificate of Incorporation (CIN), active GSTIN certificate, and an authorized corporate purchase order or service agreement.

faqs.question: How do you handle invoice disputes or line-item discrepancies?
faqs.answer: Under our Transparent Billing SLA, any disputed line item is frozen and audited against GPS telematics and digital fuel/toll logs within 48 hours. The remainder of the invoice proceeds normally to avoid operational impact.

faqs.question: Are Victor Mobility's UAE invoices compliant with the Federal Tax Authority (FTA)?
faqs.answer: Yes. All invoices are issued as formal electronic tax invoices containing our active Tax Registration Number (TRN), itemized 5% VAT calculation, and full company legal details compliant with UAE tax laws.

faqs.question: How are Dubai Salik tolls and parking fees billed?
faqs.answer: Salik toll charges are tracked electronically through automated gate reads (AED 4 per toll gate) and itemized line-by-line without manual markup. Parking charges at airports or private venues are accompanied by digital receipts.

faqs.question: Can multinational companies set up cross-entity billing in the UAE?
faqs.answer: Yes. We support consolidated multi-subsidiary billing, allowing central corporate finance to receive itemized department-wise or project-wise expense statements across Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

faqs.question: What is the procedure for onboarding our enterprise onto corporate credit?
faqs.answer: Simply provide a copy of your UAE Commercial Trade License, VAT TRN certificate, and signed corporate service agreement. Account activation and credit facility setup are finalized within 24 to 48 hours.
